selection.description: Core 2 retains the first source checkpoint’s validated layouts, lazy semantic recipes, final-slot decoding and general DataTable rows. It adds a bounded complete type-prefix read with the original diagnostic fallback, length-bucket lookups for the immutable embedded schema and qualified native identities, and safe one-pass Latin-1 conversion. The public owned model and API remain unchanged.

rejectedAdditions.namePair126: Direct comparisons 142/144 favored the type-prefix-only reader.
rejectedAdditions.scalarArrays157: Direct comparison 154 showed flat corpus time and slower tables/small packages.
rejectedAdditions.explicitAlignment158: No broad elapsed-time improvement over the simpler array prototype.
rejectedAdditions.callbackApis: Different ownership contract, mixed regressions, and uncovered modeled-versus-direct entrypoint diagnostic boundary.
rejectedAdditions.sparseGuidStorage: Rust field API break and broader regressions.

selection.dependency: encoding_rs 0.8.42, alloc only/default features disabled; declared Rust 1.88 matches the existing crate floor. Six locked additions; no existing versions removed.
